summary: Plan 03 (completeness-line rescope) is now fully COMPLETE (11/11 phases). Phase 11 landed modalTableauS4Keyed_complete (Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/FrameCompleteness.lean), the task's closing deliverable: if phi0 is s4Valid, the keyed S4 tableau modalTableauS4Keyed closes on it; contrapositively an open branch yields a genuine reflexive-transitive-frame Kripke countermodel. Assembled from Phase 10's modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed_hintikka, a new modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed_openBranch_initial_mem (keyed-driver analogue of the generic driver's initial-membership lemma, needed since the keyed driver is bespoke), and the already-landed modalOpenBranchS4_countermodel. During this dispatch, instantiating the Phase 10 induction's per-index invariant at the literal tableau entry (required to close Phase 11) was found to be unprovable as originally landed: modalTableauS4Keyed's entry used keys := [] alongside a nonempty entry branch [F(phi)@0], and S4LoopInv.keysTotal requires every known world (world 0 included, since it is the entry formula's own label) to have a recorded birth key -- confirmed computationally (simp reduces the obligation to False) that no step ever mints world 0 again to backfill one. This is a bookkeeping gap in this task's own Phase 1 entry point (not a defect in the frozen task-511 S4LoopInv struct or in any already-proven Phase 1-10 theorem, all of which are generic in keys and hence unaffected). Fixed minimally by seeding the entry with keys := [(0, empty-Finset)] instead of [] -- the root world gets a trivial birth key, which trivially satisfies keysTotal/keyLowerBd/keysInUniverse/keysDistinct and requires no change to any frozen or already-proven declaration. Added a private modalTableauS4Keyed_initial (FrameCompleteness.lean) establishing the corrected entry invariant. Full CI green: lake build (project, 3253 jobs), checkInitImports, lint (2 pre-existing unrelated-file errors only), lint-style, shake, mk_all all clean for both touched files. Zero sorry (only pre-existing docstring-prose mentions). lean_verify on the new theorem and all new declarations: propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only. Regression checks (instDecidableS5Valid, modalTableauB_sound) unchanged. Decidability (s4Valid_decides/instDecidableS4Valid) remains explicitly out of scope per the plan and was neither declared nor stubbed (verified by grep) -- it is blocked on a separately-spawned soundness task per the plan's Deferred/Spawned Scope.
